questions.question:
Six shopkeepers K, P, R, X, A and C are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). C is second to the left of A. P is to the immediate right of K. X is second to the right of R. A is to the immediate left of X.

Which of the following pair of shopkeepers represents the immediate neighbours of X?
questions.solution:
1) C is second to the left of A.

2) A is to the immediate left of X.

3) X is second to the right of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9fcfb220213f80cf05f05f0afdf7b8ddcf6cbb68d07db08551bdd8a49b4d3f9f.png]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d16fc3b8db35471bb9ed9536db75e2f9f58df5d426ce6651909f58c82432da14.png] 

So, A and K is the immediate neighbours of X.

Thus, the correct answer is “A and K”.

questions.question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. Some D are A.

II. All A are B.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some B are D.

II. All D are A.

options.text: Both conclusion I and II follows

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as follows,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5afc94e61fbec28b3eda8103560967e31f1dd32cce1588ae8fd43d45210772a2.png] 

**Conclusion:**

I. Some B are D → True (Some D are A and all A are B, So those part of A who is D is also B)

II. All D are A → False (It can be possible not definite, False)

Thus, the correct answer is “Only conclusion I follows”.

questions.question:
After interchanging the given two numbers, what will be the value of 6 + 7 × 3 - 8 ÷ 4?

3 and 6
questions.solution:
Given equation: 6 + 7 × 3 - 8 ÷ 4 = ?

After interchanging 3 and 6,

3 + 7 × 6 - 8 ÷ 4

3 + 7 × 6 - 2

3 + 42 - 2

45 - 2

43.

Thus, the correct answer is “43”.

questions.question: In a certain code language, ‘GUD’ is written as ‘31’, ‘PUH’ is written as ‘44’. What is the code for ‘FAR’ in that code language?
questions.solution:
The logic follows here is:-

Sum of the letters place value - 1,

GUD → G + U + D → 7 + 21 + 4 = 32; 32 - 1 = 31,

PUH → P + U + H → 16 + 21 + 8 = 45; 45 - 1 = 44,

Similarly,

**FAR → F + A + R → 6 + 1 + 18 = 25; 25 - 1 = 24.**

Thus, the correct answer is “24”.

Add the first three value of column and multiplied by 2.

questions.question:
By interchanging the given two signs which of the following equation will be correct?

+ and -
questions.solution:
By interchanging + and - and check the option,

1) 9 + 16 - 11 × 2 = 3

9 - 16 + 11 × 2 = 3

9 - 16 + 22 = 3

31 - 16 = 3

15 = 3 False.

2) 13 - 14 × 3 + 7 = 48

13 + 14 × 3 - 7 = 48

13 + 42 - 7 = 48

55 - 7 = 48

**48 = 48 True**

So, option 2 is true then no need to check the other option.

Thus, the correct answer is “13 - 14 × 3 + 7 = 48”.
